Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Raid Buff Off (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Cancel selected buffs during combat in selected areas.
Description: Global client. Cancel selected raid buffs only in checked Ultimate raids during combat. Job-grouped checkbox list uses current PvE status IDs and includes AST's The Balance and The Spear. Seven Ultimate areas only. DTR raidbuff: left-click ON/OFF, right-click settings. Open /rbo. Defaults OFF with empty selections.
Changelog: 0.1.1.0: DTR text is raidbuff. Seven Ultimate areas only. Remove the all-buff selector and group the screenshot raid-buff list by job, including AST's current attack cards The Balance and The Spear. Correct the original CanStatusOff-only filter by using verified PvE status IDs, excluding old/PvP namesakes. The game validates cancellation requests. Prune obsolete selections on upgrade.
